touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Grimsthorpe qualifies as a local detour through Grimsthorpe Castle and FOUNTAIN BASIN IN NORTH COURT OF GRIMSTHORPE CASTLE. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.
